_README: Pinned material map for office_room.obj. Keys are the OBJ's usemtl group names; values encode the reflectance/transmittance the names carry (R020 -> refl 0.20, T073 -> glass tvis 0.73, etc.). An on-disk map that covers every group wins over the tester's auto-generated map, so these EXACT values are used (the auto-map would otherwise default glazing to tvis 0.65 and mis-type Rad_ScreenGlass as a window). units/up_axis/north_angle_deg are read alongside the group specs. This Blender export is Z-up (height on +Z), so up_axis is Z. The window sits in the wall named North, so with north_angle_deg 0 it is a north-facing window; change north_angle_deg to reorient. REGENERATED 2026-06-29 after the OBJ gained a Rad_Luminaire_L09 group: it is type:luminaire bound to the L09_neutral fixture (IES photometry + measured SPD) so import_geometry returns a drop-in electric_lights payload for run_grid/run_image (combined daylight+electric). The luminaire ies/spd are ABSOLUTE paths so a direct import_geometry(sidecar=...) call resolves them irrespective of cwd; edit them if you relocate the repo or swap the CCT (L09_warm/L09_cool).
